name: Galaxy USDC
oneLiner: arcUSDC is Galaxy's USDC lending vault on Arc; shares redeem at NAV when liquidity is available and bear strategy losses.
collateral: USDC lender positions in one Morpho market secured by custodial cirBTC on Arc; borrower defaults and cirBTC custody risk can impair the lending claim.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue lending interest and realize losses against USDC; direct redemption uses idle USDC and a configured liquidity adapter, subject to market liquidity. A separate in-kind redemption route retains underlying lending-position exposure; forceDeallocate itself withdraws available cash to the vault. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.
